groups.description: Embrace the feeling of effortless stride with the Mizuno Wave Rider 29. Perfect for your next marathon, these versatile shoes feature the Mizuno Wave plate, which disperses energy from impact into a broader area to provide stability and cushioning. Designed to maximize energy return, these shoes enhance your efficiency and keep you moving with the next generation of Mizuno Enerzy midsole material. The legendary MIZUNO WAVE structure delivers a ride that feels both familiar and revolutionary, while eco-friendly recycled materials prove that peak performance and planet-friendly choices can stride side by side. Durable and supportive, the Mizuno Wave Rider 29 makes sure you’re always ready to go the extra mile. Mizuno Wave Rider 29 features:   Jacquard mesh upper provides breathability. Innovative gusseted tongue hugs the foot securely and comfortably. Strategic placement of carbon rubber maximizes durability in high-wear areas and enhances responsiveness. X10 outsole with carbon rubber delivers durability. Heel-to-toe drop: 10 mm. Weight: 8 oz.
